summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market share buybacks executed from April 27 to May 1, 2026. It purchased 8,001 ordinary shares at an average of ~€22.29 per share and ADSs equivalent to 540,986 ordinary shares at ~$27.41 per ADS, for cancellation. This is part of a buyback programme announced May 20, 2025, conducted under EU MAR. The purchases are routine and non-discretionary, with all shares cancelled to reduce share count. No premium, advisor, or board vote is involved. Watch for continued buyback pace as a signal of capital-return commitment.
